name: Human
description: Adaptable, generalist lineage with no pronounced biological specialization.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.description: Humans adapt quickly to whatever environment shapes them.
traits.mechanical_note: Gain one extra knowledge tag at T1 during character creation, from any domain.

name: Orc
description: Powerful and resilient, built for endurance and combat.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.description: Refusal to fall when others would.
traits.mechanical_note: Once per scene, survive a would-be incapacitating outcome at 1 HP. Take one fatigue step afterward.

name: Elf
description: Long-lived, perceptive, and attuned to subtlety.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.mechanical_note: Investigation and surveillance rolls to detect hidden or concealed things do not take the standard concealment difficulty penalty.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves rest through meditative trance rather than sleep.
traits.mechanical_note: Full rest in 4 hours instead of 8. Resting in unfamiliar environments does not add the standard unfamiliar-rest difficulty.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Elves see in near-darkness as if in dim light.
traits.mechanical_note: No darkness difficulty penalty to Perception rolls.

traits.name: Uncanny Luck
traits.description: Fate bends slightly in a halfling's favor.
traits.mechanical_note: Once per day, after seeing a roll result, declare a reroll and take either result.

traits.name: Small Stature
traits.description: Halflings disappear into crowd and cover.
traits.mechanical_note: Stealth rolls when cover or crowd is available: difficulty reduced one step.

name: Dwarf
description: Sturdy, patient, and at home in stone.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Dwarves see in near-darkness as if in dim light.
traits.mechanical_note: No darkness difficulty penalty to Perception rolls.

traits.name: Stone Sense
traits.description: Dwarves read stone and worked rock instinctively.
traits.mechanical_note: Detecting structural weakness, hidden passages, or unstable terrain in stone or underground construction: difficulty reduced one step.

name: Gnome
description: Clever, curious, and resistant to the tricks of other minds.

traits.name: Fey Resistance
traits.mechanical_note: Resistance to illusion and enchantment effects: outcomes reduced one step narratively.

traits.name: Tinker's Instinct
traits.description: Small mechanisms make immediate sense to a gnome.
traits.mechanical_note: Engineering rolls on small mechanical devices: difficulty reduced one step.

name: Tiefling
description: Infernal-blooded, willful, and resistant to burning harm.

traits.name: Infernal Resistance
traits.description: Tiefling blood shrugs off fire and death.
traits.mechanical_note: Resistance to fire and necrotic damage: outcomes reduced one step narratively.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Tieflings see in near-darkness as if in dim light.
traits.mechanical_note: No darkness difficulty penalty to Perception rolls.

name: Dragonborn
description: Dragon-descended, with breath, scale, and presence of lineage.

traits.name: Draconic Breath
traits.description: Exhale magical energy in cone or line. Breath type fixed at creation or narrative discovery.
traits.mechanical_note: Innate dragon_breath application tag at T1. Fatiguing: short rest required before repeated use in the same scene.

traits.name: Draconic Resistance
traits.description: Dragonborn resist their own breath damage type.
traits.mechanical_note: Resistance to the breath damage type established at creation: outcomes reduced one step narratively.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Dragonborn see in near-darkness as if in dim light.
traits.mechanical_note: No darkness difficulty penalty to Perception rolls.
